2-1-0.title: Choose English or Simplified Chinese
2-1-0.summary: The interface can now switch between English and Simplified Chinese, follows your browser language on first visit and remembers your choice.

changes.title: A language switch for every screen
changes.text: Choose English or 简体中文 from the account menu, the sign-in page or Settings. Your choice is remembered on this device, and the interface follows your browser language the first time you visit.
